item.summary: Central Government has approved India’s accession to the Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA) , representing a strategic milestone that reinforces India’s position in global fisheries governance. item.title: Central Government approves India’s accession to Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA)
